initialExam.title: IOCL Apprentice/Officer 2026
initialExam.description: IOCL recruits engineers and officers through GATE for refinery operations, pipeline, marketing, and R&D divisions.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech with valid GATE score or CA/MBA for non-technical
initialExam.syllabus: GATE-based for engineers. GD + Interview for all shortlisted candidates.
initialExam.examPattern: GATE Score shortlisting → GD (10%) + Interview (15%) + GATE (75%).
initialExam.selectionProcess: GATE Score → GD → Personal Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Engineer/Officer in IOCL refineries, pipelines, and marketing
initialExam.careerGrowth: Officer → Sr. Officer → Manager → DGM → GM → ED → Director.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit iocl.com 2. Register 3. Apply with GATE 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, PRP bonus, Subsidized fuel, Township
